_about: willow — an ~90s character-led launch film for an AI work companion, derived frame-by-frame from the Strawberry 1.0 launch film (Strawberry Browser, 2026-10-26; 90.0s, 1920x1080 @24fps). Stage px = reference px / 1.5. Render at --fps 24. Placeholder product: Willow, an AI crew that works beside you. Copy is role-tagged; character-art and app-footage slots are labelled dashed placeholders.
_sections: S1 overture 0-12.21 | S2 ask + outreach 12.21-25.38 | S3a companion + 'I can do' drum + 'I work in your' 25.38-31.33 | S4 docs + chat + deck + meeting toast 31.33-49.25 | S5 meetings + 'Everyone on your team' + roster 49.25-63.58 | S6 library + proof (sites counter, testimonials, crews counter) 63.58-76.96 | S3b 'Meet a new way to work' + claim + end card 76.96-90.0
